digest.component_or_area: ticket store path resolution across rebar reconciler and MCP server
propositions: Thirteen shipped code paths compose .tickets-tracker hardcoded, bypassing config.tracker_dir() resolver which supports absolute path relocation via REBAR_TRACKER_DIR env override and tracker.dir config key.
bridge_status command fails with ENOENT when ticket store is relocated outside repo root, reading from unconfigured repo_root/.tickets-tracker instead of the configured/resolved path.

MCP server deployment with relocated store (REBAR_TRACKER_DIR=/var/gerrit/site/mcp-tickets) cannot read .env-id, yet rebar list succeeds through same server using same store, proving the defect is in bridge_status path not store integrity.

Relocation is documented as supported feature in config.py:138-156 (EV-3b); 13 defects were introduced by commit fe5a447061cde creating last_pass.py without consulting existing resolver, making this a plan_defect not regression.

AC1-AC13 route hardcoded paths through config.tracker_dir() or already-resolved ReconcilerSettings.tracker_dir; AC14 enforces the boundary via check_tickets_boundary.py gate in make lint; AC15-AC17 validate bridge_status behavior unchanged in default layout and restored in relocated deployments.
